title: Routing Decision Sentinel: per-request provenance and lightweight flow snapshots
creator: Maya Ortiz
description:
Summary: Build a lightweight, per-request 'Sentinel' envelope and micro-snapshot that captures routing provenance, per-hop latency/cost signals, and the minimal rationale for each routing decision. Goal is to provide engineers an inexpensive, high-fidelity signal to diagnose region selection, tier routing and fallback model variants without retaining full request payloads.

Motivation: Current routing observability is either too sparse (only final verdict) or too heavy (full request snapshots with tokens). Teams need a middle ground: short, indexed artifacts that can be attached to traces, sampled intelligently, and used for RCA and SLO correlation.

Design highlights:
- A Sentinel payload per routed request <= 1KB that contains: global trace_id, routing_trace_id, timestamp, region_hint, selected_tier, fallback_variant_id (if any), decision_code (compact enum), per-hop latency_ms and cost_ms estimates, SLO_flags (breach candidate), and a non-sensitive decision summary token (hashed prompt fingerprint). No raw user content or tokens are included.
- Micro-snapshots (microframes) captured at each hop and emitted asynchronously to a dedicated Kafka topic 'routing-sentinel-v1'. Each microframe is one-line JSON with compact keys to minimize cost.
- Adaptive sampling: default 1% uniform sampling + automatic upsampling for requests with SLO violations, elevated error rates, or new model variants. Sampling policy configurable per-customer and per-route from Console.
- Retention/rollup: full microframes retained 7 days; nightly rollups (per-route, per-variant histograms) retained 90 days. Rollups are compact (counts, p50/p95/p99 latencies, cost deltas).
- Privacy & security: scrub all PII and user content at the edge; only hashed prompt fingerprints permitted. Sentinel data is encrypted in transit and at rest; RBAC applies via existing audit logs.
- Correlation: sentinel.trace_id links to existing request traces and to decision logs. Console will show sampled Sentinels inline on route debugging pages and make them downloadable for approved admins.

Trade-offs considered:
- Fidelity vs cost: we intentionally avoid token-level captures to keep storage and egress low. Some debugging cases will still require request-level snapshots; the Sentinel complements, not replaces, those diagnostics.
- Sampling complexity: adaptive upsampling increases ingestion bursts; mitigations include leaky-bucket backpressure and priority queues in the ingestion pipeline.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Edge enrichment layer: lightweight serializer in frontends that generates sentinel minimal envelope and forwards to local collector. (2 weeks)
2) Collector -> Kafka: batch and compress microframes into 'routing-sentinel-v1'. Include write throttles. (1 week)
3) Ingestion consumer: transform into rollups and index hot samples into ClickHouse/OLAP for quick query. (2 weeks)
4) Console integration: UI to surface sampled Sentinels on route debug pages and to drive sampling overrides. (2 sprints)
5) Ops runbook and cost guardrails: default retention and quota settings, emergency disable switch. (1 week)

Risks & mitigations:
- Burst ingestion during incidents: implement token-bucket backpressure and SLO-protected upsampling caps.
- Misconfiguration exposing PII: security review and e2e tests to ensure scrubbing at edge.

Deliverables: Sentinel spec, edge serializer, Kafka topic, ingestion consumer, rollup jobs, Console UI, runbook, and tests.
acceptance_criteria: Edge serializer emits Sentinel microframes for routed requests and payload size is <= 1KB for standard metadata set
Kafka topic 'routing-sentinel-v1' receives microframes at production load without data loss under 2x baseline traffic
Adaptive sampling policy implemented and can be overridden from Console per-route
Rollup pipeline produces daily histograms (p50/p95/p99) and cost deltas and holds 90-day retention
Console surfaces sampled Sentinels linked to a trace_id in the request debug page and allows approved users to download artifacts
Security: automated tests validate no raw prompt text or PII is present in Sentinel microframes
Runbook exists with steps to disable Sentinel ingestion and explain cost-limiting knobs
